BillHeading.Sponsors: Representatives Schmick, Walsh, Dye, Rude, Chambers, and Pollet
BillHeading.BriefDescription: Providing a designation on a driver's license or identicard that a person has a developmental disability.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to providing a designation on a driver's license or identicard that a person has a developmental disability; adding a new section to chapter 46.20 RCW; and providing an effective date.

BillSection.BillSectionHeader: Sec. 1. A new section is added to chapter 46.20 RCW to read as follows:
BillSection.P: (1) A developmentally disabled person, as defined in RCW 71A.10.020, may apply to the department to obtain a developmentally disabled designation on a driver's license or identicard issued under this section by providing:
(a) Documentation from the department of social and health services indicating current eligibility for services under Title 71A RCW; or
(b) Alternate forms of documentation which demonstrate that the individual has a developmental disability.
(2) The developmentally disabled designation must be provided to eligible individuals at no additional cost beyond other applicable driver's license or identicard fees required by law.

(3) The department, jointly with the department of social and health services, must develop procedures to allow individuals to apply for the developmentally disabled designation in the most efficient and convenient manner possible. The procedures must include public information regarding the ability to apply for the developmentally disabled designation on a driver's license or identicard.
